name: Narai
contribution: The 27th monarch of Ayutthaya Kingdom, the 4th and last monarch of the Prasat Thong dynasty.

checks.lead: King Narai the Great (Thai: สมเด็จพระนารายณ์มหาราช, RTGS: Somdet Phra Narai Maharat, pronounced [sǒm.dèt pʰráʔ nāː.rāːj mā.hǎː.râːt] ), or Ramathibodi III (Thai: รามาธิบดีที่ ๓ ), was the 27th monarch of Ayutthaya Kingdom, the 4th and last monarch of the Prasat Thong dynasty. He was the king of Ayutthaya Kingdom from 1656 to 1688 and arguably the most famous king of the Prasat Thong dynasty.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
